# contentful_resource_type (Resource)

Manages a Contentful App Resource Type and the field mappings used to display external resources in the web app. The example references the [Catalog App Resource Provider](resource_provider#example-usage). See [Contentful resource entities](https://www.contentful.com/developers/docs/extensibility/app-framework/resource-entities/) for the relationship between providers, types, and functions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "contentful_resource_type" "this" {
  organization_id   = contentful_resource_provider.this.organization_id
  app_definition_id = contentful_resource_provider.this.app_definition_id
  resource_type_id  = "${contentful_resource_provider.this.resource_provider_id}:Product"

  name = "Product"

  default_field_mapping = {
    title    = "{ /title }"
    subtitle = "{ /subtitle }"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_definition_id` (String) ID of the app definition. Changing this value replaces the resource.
- `default_field_mapping` (Attributes) Maps external resource data to the values displayed in the Contentful web app. Use JSON-pointer templates such as `{ /title }`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_field_mapping))
- `name` (String) Name of the resource type.
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization. Changing this value replaces the resource.
- `resource_type_id` (String) ID of the resource type in `ResourceProvider:ResourceType` form, for example `Catalog:Product`. The prefix must identify the app's Resource Provider. Changing this value replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite Terraform resource identifier in `organization_id/app_definition_id/resource_type_id` form.
- `resource_provider_id` (String) ID of the parent resource provider.

<a id="nestedatt--default_field_mapping"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default_field_mapping`

Required:

- `title` (String) Template for the title.

Optional:

- `badge` (Attributes) Badge field mapping. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_field_mapping--badge))
- `description` (String) Template for the description.
- `external_url` (String) Template for the external URL.
- `image` (Attributes) Image field mapping. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_field_mapping--image))
- `subtitle` (String) Template for the subtitle.

<a id="nestedatt--default_field_mapping--badge"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default_field_mapping.badge`

Required:

- `label` (String) Template for the badge label.
- `variant` (String) Template for the badge variant.


<a id="nestedatt--default_field_mapping--image"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default_field_mapping.image`

Required:

- `url` (String) Template for the image URL.

Optional:

- `alt_text` (String) Template for the image alt text.



<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) Duration for the complete operation, including retries, for example `30s` or `5m`. Defaults to `2m`.
- `delete` (String) Includes retries and uses the duration saved in state (default `2m`, minimum provider timeout `10s`).
- `read` (String) Includes retries and uses the duration saved in state (default `2m`, minimum provider timeout `10s`).
- `update` (String) Duration for the complete operation, including retries, for example `30s` or `5m`. Defaults to `2m`.

## Import

### By identity (Terraform 1.12 or later)

```terraform
import {
  identity = {
    organization_id   = var.contentful_organization_id
    app_definition_id = var.app_definition_id
    resource_type_id  = "Catalog:Product"
  }
  to = contentful_resource_type.this
}
```

### By ID (Terraform 1.5 or later)

```terraform
import {
  id = "${var.contentful_organization_id}/${var.app_definition_id}/Catalog:Product"
  to = contentful_resource_type.this
}
```

### From the command line

```shell
terraform import contentful_resource_type.this "$CONTENTFUL_ORGANIZATION_ID/$CONTENTFUL_APP_DEFINITION_ID/Catalog:Product"
```
